title: trouble's scratch-HOME proofs build their child env through home_env
intention: Every scratch-HOME child cairn/devices/trouble's proofs start gets its home through home_env, so on every platform it finds its home in the scratch and never reaches the live ~/.cairn.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienyoga9i (Windows) at cairn 96aa5dac7: cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_home_bypass(<repo>) names 3 site(s) in cairn/devices/trouble: cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_a_cli_clear_carries_the_hand.py:77 tooth_2; cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_launcher_words_are_scripts.py:101 clause_2_live_json_prints_the_same_troubles; cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_trouble_never_rides_the_bus.py:252 test_the_cli_clears_with_no_bus. Each builds a child env with HOME set to a scratch by hand, so on Windows, where Path.home() reads USERPROFILE (d95796cdfb9b), the child resolves the LIVE ~/.cairn, and none gets home_env's CAIRN_BUS_ scrub (3301915df481).
traces_to: d95796cdfb9b (a scratch HOME is the child's home on Windows too); 3301915df481; Law 3.
how: D1 each named site builds its env with home_env(home, **extra), keeping its own scrub on the result.

clauses.claim: scratch_home_bypass(<repo>) names no site under cairn/devices/trouble
each named proof file is green and a Windows run of it writes nothing under the live ~/.cairn

decisions.text: D1: at cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_a_cli_clear_carries_the_hand.py:77 tooth_2; cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_launcher_words_are_scripts.py:101 clause_2_live_json_prints_the_same_troubles; cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_trouble_never_rides_the_bus.py:252 test_the_cli_clears_with_no_bus, the env is home_env(home, **the site's other keys); a site's own key scrub applies to home_env's result.

D2: cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_launcher_words_are_scripts.py gains test_every_scratch_home_child_here_gets_its_env_from_home_env (clause 1 in PROVES), wired into its own runner: scratch_home_bypass over cairn/devices/trouble is [], so a hollow of D1 (the hand envs restored) reds a tooth. The existing teeth were green at main on Linux, so without it the hollow could not red. Measured 2026-11-13 on Linux: green; hollow (2dcff5deb reversed over the proofs) red on that tooth.

measured.what: scratch_home_bypass over the repo, sites under cairn/devices/trouble
measured.how: py -3 -c scratch.scratch_home_bypass(Path('.')) in cairn at 96aa5dac7 on akienyoga9i
